channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Mendonça quebra sigilo de investigação sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e financiamento do 'Dark Horse'
item.description: STF Minister André Mendonça lifted the secrecy of 39 processes involving Banco Master, including the investigation into Flávio Bolsonaro's funding of the film 'Dark Horse'. The decision enhances transparency in electoral investigations.

item.title: Lula tenta se afastar de Moraes antes da sessão de terça
item.description: Lula attempts to distance himself from Moraes ahead of Tuesday's session, while lulista activists continue alliance with the minister. The Antagonist reveals Moraes prepared, but did not release, a statement defending Lula. A confidential document may complicate the defense strategy.

item.title: Bilenky: 'Eleição sofre com a crise no STF, mas tem vida própria'
item.description: Thais Bilenky states that, despite the crisis at the STF and federal police investigations affecting the political landscape, the 2026 election has its own dynamics and remains undefined. On the show 'A Hora da Pesquisa', she analyzes the latest polls with José Roberto de Toledo. Expectations for the election remain uncertain due to institutional instability.

item.title: Crise no STF: Mendonça volta a defender o afastamento do chefe da PF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça defended the provisional removal of Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues and Intelligence Director Leandro Almada, following a decision annulled by Court President Edson Fachin. Mendonça argued the measure aims to protect investigative independence and does not violate President Lula's authority to appoint and dismiss PF directors.

item.title: Mendonça defende decisão que afastou Andrei da PF e nega prejuízos
item.description: Minister André Mendonça defended the decision to remove the head of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, arguing that the related cases are unrelated to ongoing proceedings and rejected the AGU's claims of institutional disruption. He also approved the release of new Master Bank files, including investigations into politicians such as Ciro Nogueira and Cláudio Castro, despite pushback from fellow justices.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que STF está ‘completamente insano’ e que caso Master chega a ser ‘cômico’
item.description: Renan Santos harshly criticized the STF, calling it 'completely insane' and questioning decisions in the Master case. He defended punishing all involved, including Lula, Moraes and Flávio Bolsonaro, and claimed institutions lose value with low-quality people. Responding to polls, he said appearing with 3% is 'completely crazy' and accused Augusto Cury of running a fake internet campaign.

item.title: ‘Preciso matar esse cara’, disse Vorcaro sobre homem que teria filmado sua filha
item.description: Leaked police messages reveal that former Master Daniel owner Vorcaro ordered the killing of a man who allegedly filmed his daughter, involving the hitman known as 'Sicário', leader of a group that illegally accesses police investigations. The conversations, analyzed by Minister André Mendonça at the STF, show threats and attempts to obtain information at the Casa Amor beach club in Saint-Tropez.

item.title: TRE-SP concede direito de resposta a Tarcísio nas redes de deputado do PT
item.description: The São Paulo Electoral Court granted Governor Tarcísio de Freitas the right to reply after State Representative Antonio Donato (PT) publicly accused him of corruption without concrete evidence. The ruling raises concerns about freedom of expression when criminal allegations lack judicial backing.

item.title: Mendonça volta a defender afastamento de Andrei, diretor-geral da PF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça defended the maintenance of Andrei Rodrigues' precautionary removal as head of the Federal Police, rejecting AGU arguments. Mendonça stated the judicial decision does not violate President Lula's authority but applies legal consequences from Law 15.047/2024. The decision awaits a ruling from Edson Fachin on Andrei's continued tenure.

item.title: Quaest: aliados de Flávio lideram corrida ao governo em 9 Estados e no DF; de Lula, em 4
item.description: Quaest polls show that allies of Flávio Bolsonaro lead voter intention in nine states and the Federal District, while candidates backed by Lula lead in four. In over a dozen federative units the races are technically tied. Electoral scenarios vary by state, with different candidate profiles and alliances.

item.title: Mendonça levanta sigilo de investigação sobre ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça lifted the seal on 38 investigations, including those related to the funding of Jair Bolsonaro's biopic 'Dark Horse', linked to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The ruling responds to a request by the Attorney General's Office and increases transparency into alleged fraud at Banco Master.

item.title: Flávio repete slogan de Renan: “Marginais vão ser presos ou neutralizados”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro echoed a slogan similar to Renan Santos by stating that 'marginals will be arrested or neutralized' during an event in Manaus, criticizing criminal factions and militias. The PL candidate emphasized reclaiming territories and actions against illegal mining in the Amazon.

item.title: Vorcaro e extensão do sigilo viram disputa entre ministros do STF
item.description: STF ministers debate access to data from Daniel Vorcaro's iPhone and the extension of secrecy in Banco Master investigations, leading to clashes between Alexandre de Moraes, André Mendonça, and Cristiano Zanin. The dispute involves process transparency and alleged protection of specific political groups.

item.title: Mendonça amplia quebra de sigilo de investigações do Master
item.description: STF Minister André Mendonça expanded the confidential review of investigations into Banco Master, including cases involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), Senators Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) and Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), and former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro. The decision responded to a request from the PGR but was broader than that requested by the deputy attorney general Hindenburgo Chateaubriand Filho.

item.title: Mendonça nega interferência em decisão que afastou diretor da PF
item.description: Minister André Mendonça denied interference in the decision that removed Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues, stating he respected President Lula's powers. In a statement to STF president Edson Fachin, he defended the precautionary measure, even after it was reversed.

item.title: São Paulo anuncia contratação de Pedro Lima, lateral do Wolverhampton
item.description: São Paulo announced the signing of right-back Pedro Lima, loaned from Wolverhampton until June 2027. The 20-year-old player has previously played for Sport's youth academy and the Brazilian national team.

item.title: Datafolha: 1 em cada 4 eleitores diz que pode mudar o voto para presidente
item.description: A Datafolha poll released 23 days before the first round of the 2026 presidential election shows that 25% of voters may still change their minds, while 75% are decided. Among Lula's supporters, 84% say they are fully decided; for Flávio Bolsonaro's voters, 81% remain committed. The overall margin of error is two percentage points.

item.title: Mendonça defende manutenção do afastamento de diretor-geral da PF
item.description: Justice André Mendonça defends the continuation of Andrei Rodrigues' suspension from the Federal Police directorship, rejecting claims by the AGU regarding usurpation of presidential prerogatives. Mendonça argues there is consolidated jurisprudence from the STF allowing judicial suspension of public officials, noting his decision had majority support in the Second Chamber. He also references prior cases where STF justices overturned presidential acts, including monocratically.

item.title: Recém chegado ao Santos, Cebolinha é relacionado para jogo do Brasileirão
item.description: Everton Cebolinha, recently signed by Santos, was included in the squad for the match against Cruzeiro in the 27th round of the Brazilian Championship. The player, who left Flamengo upset, could make his debut with Santos this Saturday at 9 PM at Urbano Caldeira Stadium. The team is without Neymar Jr. and Gabigol due to injury and suspension respectively.

item.title: Mendonça defende afastamento de diretor-geral da PF e nega ter interferido em atribuições de Lula
item.description: STF minister André Mendonça defended the provisional removal of Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues, denying any interference in Lula's duties. In a statement to Chief Justice Edson Fachin, Mendonça claimed the decision is legally supported and does not violate presidential authority.

item.title: Mendonça defende afastamento de Andrei e rebate risco de crise na PF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça supported the provisional removal of PF directors Andrei Rodrigues and Leandro Almada, dismissing the AGU's claim that it could trigger an institutional crisis. He emphasized that the PF has qualified personnel to take over the roles and that the judicial decision does not violate the separation of powers or prevent the president from appointing or dismissing officials.

item.title: Campanha de Lula recebe aproximadamente R$ 41 milhões em doações
item.description: Lula's campaign (PT) raised R$40.98 million by 6:24 PM on September 11, 2026, with R$40.15 million (97.97%) coming from the PT’s national leadership, including R$40 million from the Electoral Fund. Key external donors include Erasmo Carlos Battistella (R$500K), along with smaller contributions from Petrobras-linked officials and government figures. The campaign trails behind Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), who has raised R$47.87 million so far.

item.title: Joia do Botafogo é convocada para a Seleção Brasileira sub-20
item.description: Huguinho, a midfielder for Botafogo, was called up to the Brazil U-20 national team for friendlies against Denmark, the United States, and Mexico in Spain, from September 28 to October 4. The player, regarded as one of Botafogo's promising talents, has become a starter in midfield and recently extended his contract until 2030.

item.title: Mendonça libera sigilo de novos documentos do caso Master sobre Flávio Bolsonaro, Ciro Nogueira e Jaques Wagner
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça released the seal on 18 processes related to the Mastercase, including investigations involving Flávio Bolsonaro, Ciro Nogueira, Cláudio Castro, and Jaques Wagner. The Public Prosecutor's Office (PGR) requested broader transparency, arguing that selective disclosure might create a misleading impression. A total of 53 proceedings have been unsealed so far.

item.title: Mendonça levanta sigilo de casos sobre Flávio Bolsonaro, Cláudio Castro, Ciro Nogueira e Jaques Wagner
item.description: Justice Minister André Mendonça ordered the disclosure of 38 cases related to the Master scandal, involving figures such as Flávio Bolsonaro, Cláudio Castro, Ciro Nogueira, and Jaques Wagner. The investigations allege questionable campaign funding, financial benefits, and suspicious investments. All accused deny the allegations.

item.title: Lula e Flávio empatam no 1º e no 2º turnos pela primeira vez no Datafolha
item.description: Just over three weeks before the 2026 elections, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are in a technical tie in both the first round (39% to 35%) and the second round (46% to 44%), according to a Datafolha survey released on September 11. This is the first time in the institute's historical series that the two candidates tie in both rounds. Other candidates — Augusto Cury, Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos, and Romeu Zema — are statistically tied for third place within the margin of error.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 39% no 1º turno; Flávio marca 35%; Cury, 6%
item.description: Lula leads with 39% followed by Flavio Bolsonaro at 35% and Augusto Cury at 6%. Support for Lula and Flavio rose since the prior poll; Cury fell. 6% blank/null/none, 4% undecided.

item.title: Mendonça diz que celular de Vorcaro com mensagens de Moraes não está com ele, mas com a PF
item.description: Minister André Mendonça told STF President Edson Fachin that the court’s office did not access Daniel Vorcaro’s phone, whose messages implicate Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The material remains under Federal Police custody, as ordered by Mendonça when he took over the case. Only a sealed envelope with extracted data is held by the court.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam tecnicamente no 2º turno
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on September 11, 2026 projects a technical tie in a second-round race between Lula, at 46%, and Flávio Bolsonaro, at 44%. The survey interviewed 2,002 people and matched the September 3 findings.

item.title: Leite é interrompido por Lula ao citar transposição do São Francisco
item.description: Lula interrupted governor Eduardo Leite during a speech about RS reconstruction works, rejecting comparisons to the São Francisco transposition. The president demanded faster use of R$ 6.5 billion from the Novo PAC and signed R$ 1.5 billion for Canoas drainage projects.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula são rejeitados por 46% dos eleitores, mostra Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tied for the highest rejection rates, with 46% of voters ruling each out. Flávio's rate fell from 47%, while Lula's rose from 45%, with both shifts within the poll's margin of error.

item.title: Pesquisa Datafolha: colunistas do GLOBO analisam os resultados da corrida presidencial e nos estados
item.description: The Datafolha poll released Friday (April 25) maps the presidential race and projections in key states, analyzed by GLOBO columnists. The piece highlights an interactive GLOBO quiz to identify voter alignment and discusses how the Supreme Court crisis impacts the race. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are seen as the main beneficiaries of internal judicial conflicts.

item.title: Michelle critica decisão de Moraes e diz que restrição a visitas prejudica campanha ao Senado
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro criticized Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes' decision rejecting the request to allow family members to remain at the residence during her absences, limiting visits to two hours twice a week. The former first lady claimed this restriction hinders her Senate campaign in the Federal District, where she leads voter intentions according to Datafolha poll. The defense of Jair Bolsonaro had requested family members' presence to care for him during house arrest and health issues.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 46% e Flávio Bolsonaro marca 44% no 2º turno
item.description: In a second-round poll, Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro 46% to 44%, a statistical tie within the two-point margin of error. Against four other opponents, Lula ranges from 45% to 48%, while they range from 37% to 43%. In the first round, Lula leads with 39%, followed by Flávio on 35% and Augusto Cury on 6%.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 39% no 1° turno, e Flávio Bolsonaro, 35%
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 39% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 35% of voting intentions, within the margin for a statistical tie. Augusto Cury ranks third with 6% in the survey conducted across 125 municipalities and registered with the TSE.

item.title: Datafolha: 50% desaprovam e 47% aprovam governo Lula
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows 50% disapproval and 47% approval for President Lula’s administration, compared with 51% and 45% in the previous survey. Qualitative ratings stand at 42% negative and 32% positive. The survey interviewed 2,002 people from September 8 to 10, with a two-percentage-point margin of error.

item.title: Lula tem 46% no segundo turno contra 44% de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz Datafolha
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are tied in the second round at 46% to 44%, according to Datafolha. The result remained stable compared to the previous poll. The survey, registered with the TSE, interviewed 2,002 people with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 46% em segundo turno contra Flávio Bolsonaro, que marca 44%
item.description: Datafolha shows Lula (PT) with 46% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 44% of voting intentions in a possible runoff, within the two-point margin of error. The figures are unchanged from the previous poll; 2,002 people were interviewed from September 8 to 11 amid developments in the Supreme Court crisis.

item.title: Datafolha, 2º turno: Lula, 46%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 44%
item.description: Datafolha poll released on September 11 shows Lula at 46% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 44% in a simulated runoff. The survey, commissioned by Globo and Folha, interviewed 2,002 people from September 8-10 with a ±2 percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Datafolha, 1º turno: Lula, 39%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 35%; Cury, 6%; Caiado, 4%; Renan, 3%; Zema, 2%
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on September 11 shows Lula leading with 39%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 35%. Augusto Cury trails at 6%, Ronaldo Caiado at 4%, with remaining candidates earning marginal support. The margin of error is 2 percentage points.

item.title: Celina Leão lidera com 40% das intenções ao governo do DF, diz Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Celina Leão (PP) leading the race for governor of Brazil’s Federal District with 40% of voting intentions, ahead of Arruda (PSD) and Leandro Grass (PT), both at 17%. Without Arruda, whose candidacy was rejected by the Regional Electoral Court, Celina rises to 45% and Grass reaches 19%; the survey interviewed 910 voters from September 8 to 11, with a 3-point margin of error.

item.title: Haddad diz que é preciso tirar do STF quem estiver criando problemas
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) stated that STF justices responsible for irregularities should be removed from the court. The statement was made during an interview on Rádio Pop Aparecida, commenting on the Court's actions in the Banco Master case. The candidate advocates for the disclosure of investigation details.

item.title: Cruzeiro anuncia chegada por empréstimo de Viña, campeão da Libertadores
item.description: Cruzeiro announced the signing of Uruguayan defender Matías Viña, loaned from Flamengo until December 2026. The player, who has struggled with injuries and limited playing time in Rio, now seeks a fresh start at the Minas Gerais club. With the deal confirmed, Viña is eligible for the Brazilian league, making his debut this Saturday against Santos.

item.title: TSE rejeita registro de candidatura de Marçal à Presidência
item.description: The TSE has a majority to reject Pablo Marçal's (PRTB) presidential candidacy registration. Justice Estela Aranha cited his ineligibility until 2032 and questioned whether he joined the party within the legal deadline; Dias Toffoli and Floriano de Azevedo Marques have yet to vote.

item.title: Ex-governador Gladson Cameli está inelegível e não pode ser candidato ao Senado, decide TRE-AC
item.description: The Acre Regional Electoral Court unanimously rejected former governor Gladson Cameli's Senate candidacy registration, ruling that his collegiate criminal conviction by the STJ makes him ineligible under Brazil's Clean Record Act. His defense is appealing to the STF, arguing that the conviction may still be overturned and that he was denied a second-instance review, but the reporting judge said electoral ineligibility applies automatically after a collegiate criminal conviction without requiring a final judgment.

item.title: Dark Horse: prefeitura consulta STF sobre rompimento de contrato com ONG
item.description: The mayor of São Paulo, Ricardo Nunes, announced plans to file a lawsuit with the Supreme Court to challenge the termination of a contract with the NGO Instituto Conhecer Brasil, following a ruling by Minister Flávio Dino declaring the institute inactive commercially.

item.title: Em pior semana, campanha de Lula ganha respiro com volta da relação entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Master às manchetes e freio de arrumação no PT
item.description: Lula's reelection campaign gained relief as the Banco Master investigations returned to headlines, hurting Flávio Bolsonaro. The institutional crisis at the STF and falling polls had consolidated a technical tie in the second round. The government's response, including keeping Andrei Rodrigues at the PF and new operations, eased some pressure on the PT.

item.title: Datafolha: Tarcísio tem 49% contra 29% de Haddad em SP
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on October 11 shows Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading with 49% of voting intentions against 29% for Fernando Haddad (PT) in São Paulo. Compared to the previous survey on August 21, Tarcísio gained 4 points while Haddad advanced 2 points.

item.title: Petistas e bolsonaristas já veem Cleitinho como "imbatível" em Minas
item.description: Both PT and Bolsonaro-aligned leaders in Minas Gerais already view Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos) as unbeatable for the October gubernatorial race. The strategy hinges on the idea that regardless of whether he faces a left-wing candidate like Patrus Ananias or Alexandre Kalil, or a right-wing candidate like Flávio Roscoe, the remaining votes would consolidate behind Cleitinho in a runoff. A Datafolha poll showed him rising five points to 37% (47% of valid votes), with projected victories of 54%-29% over Kalil and 59%-24% over Patrus.

item.title: Mendonça responde Edson Fachin e diz que já tirou sigilo do caso Master
item.description: Mendonça responds to Fachin by claiming the Master case secrecy has already been partially lifted, but says the order covers only the latest phase of Compliance Zero. Fachin and the PGR demanded full disclosure; Zanin asked for Vorcaro’s phone data, which Mendonça says is with the police. Investigations into Flávio Bolsonaro and Jaques Wagner remain sealed.
